0022600165.text: The Memphis Grizzlies, 6-0 and first in the Southwest and the West, host the New Orleans Pelicans, who are 2-4, fifth in the Southwest and 4 games back, and 11th in the West. Memphis is without Quinten Post, Scotty Pippen Jr., and Ty Jerome, who are all day-to-day with game-time decisions, while New Orleans is missing Jordan Poole (out, ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (out, knee bruise), and Trey Murphy III is day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the last meeting was a 114-106 Pelicans win over the Grizzlies in New Orleans on January 30, 2026, with no games yet in the 2026-27 series.
